info.title: musicsceneapi — Label Intelligence Platform (Demo)
info.description: Generated 2026-09-28 from the pinned route table (tests/regression/routes.test.js: 65 registered routes) plus handler reads in src/routes/*.js. Auth is bearer JWT (login returns {token}, 24h). Four routes are public: GET /health, POST /v3/auth/login, POST /v3/auth/forgot-password, POST /v3/auth/reset-password. All other routes require the bearer token; some additionally require the admin role. Error bodies are JSON {error: string}; this API does NOT use RFC 9457 problem details. EXPLICITLY NOT SUPPORTED (despite claims in the legacy HTML docs): API keys, webhooks, /tracks, real-time Spotify data, MCP server, ISRC/UPC/ISWC identifiers, currency-aware royalties. Data-honesty policy (Phase 1B): every metric carries a provenance block {source, observedAt, basis: measured|estimated, note?}. The Spotify integration no longer fabricates monthlyListeners or stream counts; it reports followers and popularity verbatim. Known data-quality caveats: several integrations report not_implemented; the Stats history table is never written so projections run on synthetic history; the artist development projection is a labeled placeholder until grounded in real inputs.
